author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert isn’t aimlessly bloated or needlessly padded, nor does it chase your engagement with log-in bonuses. It’s just that, frankly, to see the game through to completion there simply aren't enough hours in the day. See, every one of Crimson Desert’s myriad systems feeds into each other. 

Mechanics collide, new layers continually reveal themselves, and before you know it what you thought was a forty-hour open world adventure has turned into a major life commitment. Realistically, for most players, to finish it means missing a lot of content (if multiplying systems means it can even be finished at all). So, with this in mind: here’s fifteen reasons why I already know I’m not going to see Crimson Desert’s end credits.
title: Crimson Desert - 15 Reasons WHY I WILL NEVER FINISH IT

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re overjoyed that Crimson Desert constantly finds new ways to surprise us, with some nifty tricks tucked away under its many systems just waiting to blow our minds once we discover them. 

Of course, it’s only right that we share that joy with you and make your time in Pywel a lot easier as a result. Some of them are quite intuitive, making certain tasks a lot easier, while others are just cool ways to engage with Pywel and all it has to offer. 

Either way, this one’s definitely going to surprise you as you discover just how well this game can keep its secrets hidden from all but the most eagle-eyed players. Join us and find out new ways to enjoy your time in Pywel and the Abyss!

title: 15 Things You Didn't Know You Could Do In Crimson Desert
